title: WPSS/560/2013 of Mahesh Koranga Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 560 of 2013 (S/S)
Mahesh Koranga ...Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others
....Respondents
Mr. A.K.Bisht and Mr. Ghanshyam Joshi, Advocates for the petitioner.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyay, Standing Counsel for the Sate.

1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. By means of this petition, the present petition has been
moved by the petitioner for a direction to the respondents to
pay arrears of salary to the petitioner from 13.08.2007 to
18.08.2010 alongwith 18% interest and also for
consequential benefits. Further prayer has been made for
directing the respondents to decide the representation of the
petitioner.

2
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended than on
13.08.2007 the service of the petitioner was terminated.
Services of other employees were also terminated in similar
manner. Petitioner as well as other similar situated
employees filed writ petition no. 1313 of 2007 before this
Court. Same was allowed and impugned termination orders
were quashed. Against the said order special appeal was
filed by the State which was dismissed. The respondents
paid entire arrears of salary to one similarly situated
employee who was party in the Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1313
of 2007 but salary to the petitioner has not been paid. The
petitioner moved several representations before the
respondents to grant the arrears of their salary from the date
of termination till the date he was given rejoining in the
department but nothing has been done so far. Therefore, the
petitioner filed present writ petition before this court.
4. During the pendency of present writ petition, the
respondents have made payment of arrears of salary to the
other similarly situated employees, but salary for the period
in question has not been paid the petitioner. This fact is
admitted to the respondents that salary of other employees
has already been paid.
5. Since, the respondents have already paid the salary to
other employees for the period in question, the respondents
cannot take different stand in the matter of the petitioner.
Considering all these facts, I direct the respondents to make
payment of arrears of salary to the petitioner from

3
13.08.2007 to 18.08.2010. Other consequential benefits will
also be given to the petitioner. Payment shall be made within
four months from the date of production of certified copy of
order.
6. This disposes of the writ petition. All pending
applications stand disposed of.
 (V.K.Bist, J.)
25.10.2013
Nahid
